# Reha Seeblick: discharge report

Patient: Maria Beispiel, born 12 March 1961
Stay: 28 September to 19 October 2026
Reason: rehabilitation after surgery for a fracture of the right wrist on 15 September 2026

## Course

Maria came with a cast-free wrist and limited movement. With daily occupational therapy the range of motion improved clearly. She can write and use cutlery again.

## Medication at discharge

- Ibuprofen 400 mg up to twice a day if needed

## Recommendations

- Continue the hand exercises daily.
- Occupational therapy once a week for four weeks.
